articles.title: Polymarket Sign Up Bonus ACTION: Deposit $10, Get $25 for Packers vs. Rams Prediction
articles.summary: Polymarket is running a $10 deposit, $25 bonus promotion timed to the Packers-Rams game, basically handing free capital to anyone willing to sign up and start trading. The play matters because sign-up bonuses are how prediction market platforms lock in new users during sports peaks, and $25 free gives fresh money enough juice to actually move small-cap markets.

articles.title: MGM Resorts and BetMGM leave problem gaming organization over the group's ties with Kalshi
articles.summary: MGM Resorts and its sportsbook BetMGM are ditching a problem gambling advocacy group because the organization maintains ties with Kalshi, the political prediction market platform. The move signals how prediction markets are becoming polarizing enough that even gambling companies want distance from groups associated with them.

articles.title: 16 Polymarket Accounts Make Over $340,000 Betting on Jensen Huang's Nvidia Return Before Announcement
articles.summary: Sixteen Polymarket traders netted over $340K betting that Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang would return from his health leave before the company officially announced it. Either these accounts had genuine inside information, or prediction markets just proved they're better at reading tea leaves than official corporate communications.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Polymarket code “SILIVE” extends $25 referral promo for Celtics-Wizards
articles.summary: Polymarket's running a $25 referral bonus using code "SILIVE" that's now extended through the Celtics-Wizards matchup, meaning fresh users can stack free capital on NBA action. More free money floating around = higher trading volumes and tighter spreads on basketball markets, which is exactly what prediction markets need to stay competitive against traditional sportsbooks.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, likely for sponsorship or official betting integration. This matters because it signals major sports leagues are finally comfortable going all-in on prediction markets instead of just tolerating them from the sidelines.

articles.title: Simon Denny on Prediction Markets, Speculation, and the Future of Truth
articles.summary: Simon Denny's latest thinks prediction markets are becoming a legitimate alternative to traditional institutions for establishing what's actually true. That matters because if markets start replacing media and academia as our truth arbiters, the entire game of prediction betting gets a credibility upgrade (or a credibility problem, depending on who's doing the predicting).

articles.title: KKR Curbs Staff Betting on Prediction Markets
articles.summary: KKR restricted employees from trading on prediction markets, apparently worried about conflicts of interest or regulatory blowback from staff making bets tied to companies in their deal flow. It's a bellwether moment: if major financial institutions start locking down internal prediction market access, we're looking at serious regulatory tightening that could reshape how these markets function at scale.

articles.title: Utah drops criminal charges against Kalshi founders after company suspended operations in state
articles.summary: Utah's prosecutors quietly dropped their case against Kalshi's founders after the prediction market platform voluntarily yanked itself from the state, essentially getting regulators to blink first. The move signals that even hostile state governments may eventually fold when crypto-adjacent betting platforms remove the friction, which matters enormously for Kalshi's expansion strategy and for anyone betting on whether prediction markets actually go mainstream in America.

articles.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
articles.summary: Kalshi, the SEC-approved prediction market platform, has a minor problem: minors were betting on it, losing nearly $9M in New York City alone before regulators noticed. This is exactly the kind of regulatory headache that could tighten age verification requirements across the entire prediction market industry, making onboarding slower and more annoying for everyone else.

articles.title: Louisiana man allegedly threatened AG Liz Murrill’s life over battle with prediction markets
articles.summary: A Louisiana man allegedly made death threats against Attorney General Liz Murrill while she's actively pursuing legal action against prediction markets operating in the state. The escalation signals how heated the political and legal fight over online betting has become, potentially influencing how aggressively regulators move forward on enforcement.

articles.title: NYC calls on Kalshi, Polymarket to testify on marketing to youth
articles.summary: NYC's government is demanding that prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket explain how they're marketing to minors, suggesting regulators think they're doing it too aggressively. This is the opening move in what could become a broader regulatory crackdown that makes it harder for these platforms to operate or advertise in the country's largest city.
